title: Health, Life Evaluation and Security
summary: Physical and psychological load directly affect the ability to act, life evaluation provides a person's subjective reading of their circumstances, and security and uncertainty influence whether people can undertake transitions, learning and long-term plans.
shortAnswer: Physical and psychological load directly affect the ability to act, life evaluation provides a person's subjective reading of their circumstances, and security and uncertainty influence whether people can undertake transitions, learning and long-term plans.

blocks.text: Physical and psychological load directly affect the ability to act, life evaluation provides a person's subjective reading of their circumstances, and security and uncertainty influence whether people can undertake transitions, learning and long-term plans.

Subjective evaluation and objective conditions must both be retained without substituting for one another. Health or happiness is not reduced to a single score, and individual reports are not used to infer the condition of an entire society by themselves.

This article remains within the completed Book VI manuscript; B6-WEB-B does not add live current-data population. Subjective experience and structural conditions remain distinct, and no single measure is used to infer a person or an entire society.
